name: overdrive

params.name: drive
params.doc: Gain into the tanh curve. Q8.8: 1.0 (raw 256) = unity, 8.0 (raw 2048) = 8x.

params.name: tone
params.doc: Same one-pole tilt as distortion. (Not implemented in the RTL yet.)

params.name: asymmetry
params.doc: 0 = symmetric; higher adds even harmonics. (Not implemented in the RTL yet.)

status: tone and asymmetry are not implemented in the RTL yet
